body:
Hi @JonnyTurnerUK sorry for the late response. I believe you are using a custom widget, could you maybe give us the code of the custom widget here?

What may be the source of your issues here is that ultimately you would want to use a "disjunctive facets" that would allow you to not only refine on a facets but keep showing the other facet values.

For this to work, I would advise you to change facets and facetsRefinements to disjunctiveFacets and disjunctiveFacetsRefinements.

The use case of default selected filters is very important to us because more and more frequent. This is today a pain to use and we want to make it easier.
